name: Audi R26

hotspots.name: Front wing
hotspots.details: From 2026 the front wing is 100 mm narrower than before and uses a two-element flap. Together with the rear wing it switches between high-downforce Z-mode in corners and low-drag X-mode on designated straights.

hotspots.name: Nose cone
hotspots.details: The nose is part of the front impact structure. 2026 cars are also shorter overall: the maximum wheelbase is 3,400 mm, 200 mm less than the previous generation, so the whole car should change direction more quickly.

hotspots.name: Halo
hotspots.details: The titanium halo sits over the cockpit to protect the driver's head. Formula 1 made it mandatory in 2018 after years of testing, and it remains on the 2026 cars.

hotspots.name: Cockpit
hotspots.details: The open cockpit sits under the halo, with the steering wheel and display just ahead of the driver. This model wears number 27, Nico Hülkenberg's career number, which he kept for Audi's first Formula 1 season in 2026.

hotspots.name: Rear-view mirrors
hotspots.details: The mirrors are mounted outboard of the cockpit so the driver can see cars behind. They are treated as separate from the main bodywork in the technical regulations.

hotspots.name: Engine airbox
hotspots.details: The intake above the driver's head feeds the power unit. For 2026 that unit is still a 1.6-litre V6 turbo hybrid, but output is split roughly evenly: about 400 kW from the engine and 350 kW from the electric motor, with 8.5 MJ of energy recoverable each lap.

hotspots.name: Sidepod
hotspots.details: The sidepods house radiators and shape the airflow along the floor. 2026 cars are 100 mm narrower than before, at a maximum of 1,900 mm, which also trims the bodywork in this area.

hotspots.name: Front wheel (18-inch)
hotspots.details: Pirelli's 18-inch wheels, introduced in 2022, stay for 2026. The front tyres are 25 mm narrower than the previous generation, which cuts both drag and unsprung weight. The little wheel-wake 'hats' above the front tyres are gone.

hotspots.name: Rear wheel (18-inch)
hotspots.details: The rear 18-inch Pirelli tyres are 30 mm narrower than before. Together with the shorter 3,400 mm maximum wheelbase, the aim is a lighter, more agile car (minimum weight 768 kg, 30 kg less than 2022-spec cars).

hotspots.name: Rear wing
hotspots.details: The 2026 rear wing has three elements and no longer uses the lower beam wing of the previous generation. In X-mode its flaps flatten for low drag on the straight; in Z-mode they produce more downforce for corners.

hotspots.name: Rear rain light
hotspots.details: The bright red light at the tail helps other drivers spot the car in spray and darkness. On this model it sits in the centre of the rear bodywork, just below the wing.

hotspots.name: Number 27
hotspots.details: This livery carries Nico Hülkenberg's number 27. In 2026 the former Kick Sauber team became the Audi Revolut F1 Team; Hülkenberg and Gabriel Bortoleto (#5) are its first works-team drivers, and the chassis code is R26.
